title: Skip static top-bar filenames during keyboard navigation
steps: View the open Meeting notes.txt document and its filename in the top bar, with Close as the starting keyboard position.
Press Shift+Tab twice to move focus from Close through Show context menu onto the filename in the top bar.
Press Enter while the filename is focused and inspect the resulting page.

video_guide.summary: Reverse Tab reaches the document filename; after Enter, its outline and the open document remain visible.

chapters.note: Meeting notes.txt is open in Text Editor, with Close at the right end of the document toolbar.
A Close tooltip is visible beneath the toolbar control.

chapters.label: Press Shift+Tab to move backward from Close.

chapters.note: The three-dot control has a focus outline and a Show context menu tooltip.
The Meeting notes.txt filename has a rectangular focus outline.

chapters.label: Press Enter while the filename is focused.

chapters.note: The filename is outlined, the document text is visible, and no menu is open.
The filename is outlined above the open Meeting notes document.
